essence: Heart withheld from yoginī-born and Rudra; swift yoga-release.
Right utterance: host face to face, body-possession-marked.
Remembered a moment in kiss, navel-sealed: binds body and host.
Asked tells past-future; within a watch, god-form uttered.
Undoubted seen, Rudra-drawn; two watches, sky-standing.
By three: mothers, heroes, perfected, śākinī-host gather.
Come, pledge got, urged: supreme fruit, whatever wished.
By this the perfected perfect; all in tantra succeeds.
Unseen circle truly known: shares fruition, yogin, initiated.

rasa.justification: Wonder at exhibited efficacy — withheld heart, face-to-face host, past-future told, mothers gathered — braced by vīra: powers wielded (bound, effected, succeeds).

sections.BOUNDARY: No fruit is tasted; knowing begins beyond the powers.
sections.EXPLANATION: Exclusion (neither yoginī-born nor Rudra plainly gets the swift heart). Rightly uttered host stands face to face, body-marked (fused pādas kept). Remembered a moment in the kiss, navel-sealed: binds body and host (cummake kept). Asked tells past and future; within a watch the meant god-form uttered. Undoubted seen, Rudra-drawn; two watches, sky-standing, remembering. By three the mothers — heroes, perfected, śākinī-host (ñcch kept) — come, pledge got (labdhvā, not given), urged: supreme fruit, whatever wished. By this the perfected perfect, mantra-men effected; all in Bhairava-tantra from this succeeds (GRETIL v18ab absorbed here; v18cd absent entire work). Unseen circle truly known shares fruition ever — yogin and initiated.
sections.FUNCTION: Demonstrates the heart's efficacy: exclusion, utterance, memory, vision, host, success.
sections.KEY TERMS: hṛdaya (withheld heart); sanmukhatā (face-to-faceness); cumbaka (kiss — open); prahara (watch — speed); labdhvā (having got — vs dattvā); śākinīgaṇa (host); adṛṣṭamaṇḍala (unseen circle).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Powers pledged in the opening question are exhibited here before fruit is tasted.
sections.RELATED: G18cd absent (mantravīryasamāveśaprabhāvān na niyantriṇā nowhere in M00044) — the no-controller clause lives only in GRETIL; no absorption invented.
sections.SUMMARY: Withheld from yoginī-born and Rudra alike, the heart gives swift release. Rightly uttered, the host stands face to face, body-marked. Remembered a moment in the kiss, navel-sealed: binds body and host. Asked, past and future told; within a watch, the god-form uttered. Undoubted seen, Rudra-drawn; two watches, sky-standing. By three the mothers gather — heroes, perfected, śākinī-host; come, pledge got, urged: supreme fruit, whatever wished. By this the perfected perfect, all in tantra succeeds. Unseen circle truly known shares fruition ever — yogin and initiated.
